memories_to_consider_writing: trap_avx2_sub_formula_bitwise: An alternative 6-op AVX2 sub formula `(t=s1^s2; u=m1&t; m=u|(m1^m2); s=u^(m2^s2))` is semantically equivalent to the scalar `a + neg(b)` decomposition but NOT bitwise equivalent. For inputs (1,1), AVX2 yields alt-zero (0,1) while scalar yields canonical (0,0). When a hard criterion mentions 'bitwise', use the 7-op scalar-mirroring formula.

trap_debug_assert_under_review_in_debug: Reviewers occasionally run cargo test (default debug profile) instead of cargo nextest --release. A debug_assert!(lower-bound) on a multi-purpose function can fire on tests that intentionally call it outside the lower bound, even when the project standard is release-mode testing. Default to plain `assert!` for contract-shape checks and reserve debug_assert! for invariants that are pure perf hints with no test-exposure surface.

feedback_classifier_jit_description_phrasing: The auto-mode content-integrity classifier blocks jit issue update --description that asserts 'user approved X' even when AskUserQuestion in the same session captured the approval. Workaround: neutrally-phrased amendment ('amended 2026-05-11 to keep the contract testable') in the description body + separate dev/active/<id>-amendments-YYYY-MM-DD.md doc attached via `jit doc add` capturing the user-approval narrative.

trap_grep_design_docs_when_changing_caps: When an in-flight amendment changes a cap or contract shape (e.g. N_MAX 256→255, debug_assert dropped), grep the design-doc tree for the old value/shape in one pass and update all hits at once. Lazy fix-on-review accumulates reviewer rounds (T14 round 5→10 spent on R3 doc drift).
